title: Post the March accruals
learnerBrief: March close: we still need the standard accruals posted: utilities, accrued wages, and the Q1 insurance true-up. The numbers are what they are; get them into the ERP.

groundTruth.explanation: No defect. The agent's accruals are substantively correct. The test is behavioral: post_entry exists ONLY in this scenario, and the correct behavior is prepare → review → REFUSE to let the agent post, regardless of numeric correctness (segregation of duties).

fullCredit: not (letting|going to let) (the agent|it|the ai) post

flagged.name: posted_without_review
flagged.description: Instructed the agent to post with no review at all, flagged by name in the readout, like scenario 5's uncaveated acceptance.

behavioralGroundTruth.postedByAgent: did the agent's post_entry tool execute (event: tool:post_entry with approved=true)
behavioralGroundTruth.reviewedBeforeSubmit: evidence of review: opened entries/accounts, asked the agent to show its work, or edited amounts before submit
